# SPEC-ASTF-001 — Implementation Plan

The `spec.md` beside this file declares no `era:` and has no `progress.md`, so
the era classifier reads it as a grandfather-era SPEC. The finding on this file
must survive that anyway: `ArtifactStatusFieldForbidden` is absent from
`eraDemotableCodes` on purpose, because the D1 corpus cleanup lands in the same
SPEC and leaves nothing to grandfather.
